title: Provisioning attestation (patt_…) — signed
description: A signed record by the identity that ran a test provisioning (the attester), naming the dish, the recipe, the harness plate, the instance, the result, the cause class on failure, and the receipts and trace (R5, R6; decisions 32, 36). Modelled on spec/certification.schema.json rather than on the `verified` claim (design-phase finding: the attestation carries fields a claim cannot). Hashed and signed exactly as a certification: `hash` over the JCS form with `hash` and `signature` removed; `signature` over the form with only `signature` removed, so it covers the hash; the signer's key is the `from` DID. Any attester can reproduce the test from the harness plate and instance.

harness_plate.description: The dish under test plus an offered dish for each of its input wires (decision 36).

instance.description: The test instance: a lineage of its own, one generation per attempt, test-marked names.

cause.description: Required when `result` is `fail`. A dish fault makes the dish unprovisionable; an environment fault is no verdict.

detail.description: For `fail`: the step and what the cloud answered, in plain words.

receipt.description: The provisioning receipt of the test run (every step ran, every resource reached ready, the outputs were produced).

scrub_receipt.description: The scrub receipt that followed; a pass requires every resource confirmed gone. A partial scrub receipt here means the attester has something left to clean up.

trace.description: The run's recorded effect trace. Test provisioning traces are always kept (R5).
